groups.label: Original control
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table I, HathiTrust scan 7 and Project 216-1, Results p. 2 (scan 4)
groups.note: Project 216 prints 0.5% for the combined bends-and-chokes descent cell. The 1946 article prints 0.45% for the same 223-flight protocol. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: Classification chamber 1
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table I, HathiTrust scan 7 and Project 216-1, Results p. 2 (scan 4)
groups.note: Classification controls counted only through 120 minutes. These 331 flight records reappear in the 950- and 727-flight pooled groups. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: Classification chamber 2
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table I, HathiTrust scan 7 and Project 216-1, Results p. 2 (scan 4)
groups.note: Classification controls counted only through 120 minutes. These 396 flight records reappear in the 950- and 727-flight pooled groups. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: Pooled untreated controls
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table II, HathiTrust scan 8 and Project 216-1, Table III, HathiTrust scan 9
groups.note: Table III gives 24.4% (SE 0.7 percentage points); p. 2 gives 22.4% as the reference for the ground-level comparison. The flight mix that might account for this difference is unavailable. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: Ground level
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table II, HathiTrust scan 8 and Project 216-1, Table III, HathiTrust scan 9
groups.note: The original site altitude is 750 ft. The matching journal group reports 15 minutes of ground-level oxygen. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: 15,000 feet
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table II, HathiTrust scan 8 and Project 216-1, Table III, HathiTrust scan 9
groups.note: Fifteen-minute oxygen stop during ascent. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: 20,000 feet
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table II, HathiTrust scan 8 and Project 216-1, Table III, HathiTrust scan 9
groups.note: Fifteen-minute oxygen stop during ascent. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: 25,000 feet
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table II, HathiTrust scan 8 and Project 216-1, Table III, HathiTrust scan 9
groups.note: Fifteen-minute oxygen stop during ascent. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: 30,000 feet
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table II, HathiTrust scan 8 and Project 216-1, Table III, HathiTrust scan 9
groups.note: Fifteen-minute oxygen stop during ascent. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.

groups.label: 38,000 feet
groups.locator: Project 216-1, Table II, HathiTrust scan 8 and Project 216-1, Table III, HathiTrust scan 9
groups.note: Results p. 2 identifies the two classification groups and a 135-minute outcome window. The legacy journal extraction records 120 as the nominal duration. The 727 flights also contribute their first 120 minutes to the pooled control. The source's column label does not describe a separate oxygen stop. Timing means apply to the subset of forced descents for severe bends. Its denominator is not printed.
